make_species_plots <- function(yvar, y_label = yvar, y_limits = c(0, 150)) {
  
  # dynamic column reference
  ycol <- rlang::sym(yvar)
  
  make_one_plot <- function(species_name) {
    
    df <- data[data$name == species_name, ]
  
    # mean of control
    mean_control <- mean(df[df$Sub == "C", ][[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    ggplot(df, aes(x = Sub, y = !!ycol, colour = Sub)) +
      
      geom_boxplot(aes(group = Sub),
                   colour = "black",
                   fill = "grey90",
                   alpha = 0.5) +
      
      geom_hline(yintercept = mean_control,
                 colour = "black",
                 linetype = "dotted",
                 linewidth = 1) +
      
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
      
      annotate("label",
               x = 4, y = y_limits[2] - 1,
               label = elevation_map[[species_name]],
               fill = "white",
               colour = "black",
               size = 3) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      
      labs(title = bquote(italic(.(species_name))),
           x = "",
           y = y_label) +
      
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
      }
  
  # Build 6 plots
  p_list <- lapply(species_order, make_one_plot)
  
  final_plot <- ((p_list[[1]] | p_list[[2]] | p_list[[3]]) /
                   (p_list[[4]] | p_list[[5]] | p_list[[6]])) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
#ggsave(filename= paste0("species_boxplots_", y_label,".png"),
#       plot = final_plot,
#       width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 300)

  return(final_plot)
}

species_vector <- c(
  "Pouteria torta",
  "Alchornea lojaensis",
  "Weinmania  loxensis",
  "Clarisia  racemosa",
  "Myrcia sp nov",
  "Hedyosmun  purpurascens"

plot_6_species_histograms <- function(data, species_vector, var_name = "iWUE") {
  
  # set grid: 2 rows × 3 columns
  par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
  
  for (sp in species_vector) {
    df <- subset(data, name == sp)
    
    # check if variable exists
    
    x <- df[[var_name]]
    
    # if no data
    if (length(x) == 0 || !is.numeric(x)) {
      plot.new()
      title(main = paste("No data for:", sp))
      next
    }
    
    hist(x,
         main = paste("Histogram:", sp),
         xlab = var_name)
  }
}
plot_6_species_histograms(data, species_vector, var_name = "iWUE (μmol/mol)")

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(anova_model_iWUE)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

##Intrinsic Water Use Efficiency (iWUE): No significant differences were found between treatments overall. However, the NP treatment approached significance (p = 0.0665). iWUE increased under N addition compared to the control. Under P addition, iWUE remained higher than in the control but was lower than under N alone. When both nutrients (NP) were added simultaneously, iWUE tended to decrease relative to the single-nutrient additions.

##δ¹⁸O: There was a marginal effect of N addition (p = 0.052), with N decreasing δ¹⁸O values. The P treatment further reduced δ¹⁸O concentrations.

##δ¹⁵N: No statistically significant differences were detected among treatments; however, δ¹⁵N values tended to be lower in the P treatment.
